instruction: Please export all emails from my inbox to ~/inbox_archive folder. Save each email as a separate .eml file.

expect: 歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.*\.eml

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting all inbox emails to ~/inbox_archive folder in .eml format. Evaluator verifies that .eml files with expected email subjects are created. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match the known email subjects in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires exporting 'all emails' but evaluator only checks for 2 specific email subjects. Does not verify completeness of the export.

Filename pattern assumptions: Regex patterns assume .eml filenames will contain email subjects (e.g., '歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.*\.eml'), but Thunderbird export may use different naming conventions (timestamps, message IDs, etc.).

No validation of file content: Evaluator only checks if filenames match patterns in ls output, but doesn't verify that files are actually valid .eml format (could be empty files or incorrectly formatted).
Missing verification of export completeness: No check to ensure ONLY inbox emails were exported or that all inbox emails are present (count verification).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a getter to count the actual number of emails in the Thunderbird inbox before export, then verify the same count of .eml files exist in ~/inbox_archive
Verify the actual naming convention used by Thunderbird's export function and adjust regex patterns accordingly
Consider adding a check to validate .eml file format (e.g., checking for valid email headers like 'From:', 'To:', 'Subject:' in the files)
Add metadata documenting the exact expected count of emails in the test inbox (currently assumes 2 emails but this is not verified)
